03 — Practice Area

Government Contracts & Federal Contractor Compliance

Federal contracting is one of the most lucrative — and legally unforgiving — markets a business can enter. The compliance obligations don't pause between contracts, and the consequences of getting them wrong include suspension, debarment, and the loss of everything you've built in that space. We advise small businesses, emerging federal contractors, and established operators on SAM.gov compliance, bid protests, contract disputes, and the regulatory frameworks governing federal procurement.

What We Protect

Every dimension of the matter, mapped before it moves.

  • —SAM.gov registration, compliance, and renewal integrity
  • —Your right to compete — bid protest strategy and execution
  • —Your contract — disputes, claims, and termination defense
  • —Your standing — suspension and debarment prevention and response
